title: Cheese Crusted Omurice (Crispy Cheese Japanese Omelette Rice) - Okonomi Kitchen
ldKeywords: cheese crusted omurice, crispy cheese omurice, gochujang fried rice omurice, spicy omurice recipe, Japanese omelette rice, Korean fusion rice, easy omurice recipe, cheesy egg rice
ldIngredientsRaw: 1 1/4 cup (250 g) prepared fried rice (see gochujang version below, or use ketchup rice, kimchi fried rice, curry fried rice or garlic rice, etc.)
1.5 oz (42 g) ground beef (or chicken, spam, bacon, ham, sausage, etc)
1 green onion, sliced (separate white and green parts)
1/4 cup (50 g) kimchi, roughly chopped, optional
1 cup (200 g) cooked rice, preferably day old
1–3 tsp soy sauce (1 tsp if using kimchi, 3 tsp if not)
htmlIngredientLines: [Fried Rice (250 g total, use any style)]
1 1/4 cup (250 g) prepared fried rice (see gochujang version below, or use ketchup rice, kimchi fried rice, curry fried rice or garlic rice, etc.)
1.5 oz (42 g) ground beef (or chicken, spam, bacon, ham, sausage, etc)
1 green onion, sliced (separate white and green parts)
1/4 cup (50 g) kimchi, roughly chopped, optional
1 cup (200 g) cooked rice, preferably day old
1–3 tsp soy sauce (1 tsp if using kimchi, 3 tsp if not)
